docs.title: ChatTree
docs.text:
ChatTree 是 ChatArch tree-oriented workflows 的 Python CLI 包壳。当前公开 CLI 只提供包信息与真实命令树；后续新增 tree 能力时，应先落到可复用 Python API，再扩展 CLI、文档和测试。

  • CLI 树

    查看当前真实命令面：chattree --tree / chattree --tree-brief。

  • Tree 边界

    当前版本是轻量入口，不读取或修改真实项目树。

  • 验证契约

    --tree、--tree-brief、README、MkDocs 和测试必须同步更新。

docs.title: 开发验证
docs.text:
pip install -e ".[dev,docs]"
python -m pytest -q
mkdocs build --strict
python -m build

docs.title: CLI 树
docs.text:
ChatTree 当前是 root-only CLI，并使用共享的 chatstyle.add_tree_option() 从真实注册的 Click command surface 生成命令树：

  • chattree --tree 显示参数签名，适合接口审查。
  • chattree --tree-brief 保留同一组节点和说明，但省略参数签名。

当前没有业务命令参数，因此完整和简洁视图相同。这个页面不能手写未来命令；模板 hello 命令不属于公开接口。

docs.title: 完整命令树
docs.text:
chattree
├── --help  # Show this message and exit.
├── --version  # Show the version and exit.
├── --tree  # Print the registered CLI tree and exit.
└── --tree-brief  # Print the registered CLI tree without parameter signatures and exit.

docs.title: 简洁命令树
docs.text:
chattree
├── --help  # Show this message and exit.
├── --version  # Show the version and exit.
├── --tree  # Print the registered CLI tree and exit.
└── --tree-brief  # Print the registered CLI tree without parameter signatures and exit.

docs.title: 状态契约
docs.text:
• chattree --help 必须暴露 --tree 和 --tree-brief。
  • chattree --tree 必须 exit 0，并显示带参数签名的真实注册面。
  • chattree --tree-brief 必须 exit 0，并显示省略参数签名的同一注册面。
  • chattree hello 必须失败；hello 不是业务命令。
  • 当前入口只输出文本，不读取或修改项目树，也不打印或保存敏感值。
  • 新增 tree 能力时，先增加可复用 Python API，再新增 CLI command，并同步完整/简洁树。

docs.title: ChatTree
docs.text:
ChatTree is the ChatArch Python CLI package shell for tree-oriented workflows. The public CLI currently exposes package metadata and the real command tree only; future tree capabilities should start with reusable Python APIs before extending CLI commands, docs, and tests.

  • CLI Tree

    Inspect the current real command surface: chattree --tree / chattree --tree-brief.

  • Tree Boundary

    The current version is a lightweight entrypoint and does not read or mutate real project trees.

  • Verification Contract

    --tree, --tree-brief, README, MkDocs, and tests must stay synchronized.

docs.title: Development Verification
docs.text:
pip install -e ".[dev,docs]"
python -m pytest -q
mkdocs build --strict
python -m build

docs.title: CLI Tree
docs.text:
ChatTree is currently a root-only CLI. It uses the shared chatstyle.add_tree_option() integration to generate both trees from the registered Click command surface:

  • chattree --tree includes parameter signatures for interface review.
  • chattree --tree-brief keeps the same nodes and descriptions while omitting signatures.

There are no business-command parameters yet, so the full and brief views are identical. This page must not invent future commands; the template hello command is not part of the public interface.

docs.title: Full command tree
docs.text:
chattree
├── --help  # Show this message and exit.
├── --version  # Show the version and exit.
├── --tree  # Print the registered CLI tree and exit.
└── --tree-brief  # Print the registered CLI tree without parameter signatures and exit.

docs.title: Brief command tree
docs.text:
chattree
├── --help  # Show this message and exit.
├── --version  # Show the version and exit.
├── --tree  # Print the registered CLI tree and exit.
└── --tree-brief  # Print the registered CLI tree without parameter signatures and exit.

docs.title: Status Contract
docs.text:
• chattree --help must expose --tree and --tree-brief.
  • chattree --tree must exit 0 and show the registered surface with parameter signatures.
  • chattree --tree-brief must exit 0 and show the same surface without signatures.
  • chattree hello must fail; hello is not a business command.
  • The current entrypoint only prints text; it does not read or mutate project trees or print/store sensitive values.
  • Future tree capabilities must add reusable Python APIs first, then CLI commands, and then update both trees.
